# AcaciaFund

> Research synthesis & experimental learning platform. Static-first, privacy-preserving.

AcaciaFund is a research-synthesis lab (not a fund) that scans arXiv and Hacker News, scores every piece for signal quality, and turns top results into 3-minute briefings and interactive lessons.

## Content Pillars

- [AML Compliance](https://www.acaciafund.org/aml/): Regulatory updates, transaction monitoring, compliance patterns, financial crime analysis, SARs, KYC, beneficial ownership
- [Financial Markets](https://www.acaciafund.org/stock/): Market analysis, algorithmic trading, semiconductor supply chains, industry trends, financial data engineering
- [Data Engineering](https://www.acaciafund.org/data-engineering/): Data pipelines, orchestration, quality engineering, streaming, storage, analytics infrastructure

## Recent Research

- [2027 Data Engineering Predictions](https://www.acaciafund.org/blog/2026-06-19-2027-data-engineering-predictions/): AI-Augmented Pipelines, Real-Time Universal Catalogs, and the Death of Batch
- [Data Platform as a Product](https://www.acaciafund.org/blog/2026-06-18-data-platform-product-ux/): UX Patterns for Internal Developer Platforms
- [The Rise of the Analytics Engineer](https://www.acaciafund.org/blog/2026-06-17-analytics-engineering-rise/): dbt, SQLMesh, and the Modern Data Stack
- [Cost Optimization in Data Pipelines](https://www.acaciafund.org/blog/2026-06-16-cost-optimization-data-pipelines/): Engineering for Efficiency at Petabyte Scale
- [Schema Registry Patterns](https://www.acaciafund.org/blog/2026-06-15-schema-registry-avro-protobuf/): Avro, Protobuf, and JSON Schema in Production

## Learn Lessons

- [AML Basics](https://www.acaciafund.org/learn/aml-basics/): Introduction to Anti-Money Laundering compliance
- [Market Analysis](https://www.acaciafund.org/learn/market-analysis/): Financial market analysis fundamentals
- [DataOps Introduction](https://www.acaciafund.org/learn/dataops-introduction/): Data Operations principles and practices
- [Behavioral Finance](https://www.acaciafund.org/learn/behavioral-finance-portfolio/): Behavioral finance and portfolio theory
- [Crypto AML](https://www.acaciafund.org/learn/crypto-aml/): Cryptocurrency anti-money laundering

## Knowledge Base

- [About AcaciaFund](https://www.acaciafund.org/knowledge/about/): Mission, methodology, and team
- [System Architecture](https://www.acaciafund.org/knowledge/system-architecture/): Technical infrastructure and pipeline design
- [Research Methodology](https://www.acaciafund.org/knowledge/research-methodology/): How we score and synthesize content
- [Glossary](https://www.acaciafund.org/knowledge/glossary/): Definitions of key terms
- [FAQ](https://www.acaciafund.org/knowledge/faq/): Frequently asked questions

## All Content Is Free

AcaciaFund is completely free and open. No paywalls, no premium tiers, no subscriptions required. All research briefings, interactive lessons, and knowledge base articles are freely accessible to everyone.

## Author

- **Leszek** — AML Specialist & Data Engineer. Research synthesis, content automation, platform architecture.

## Technical Details

- Static site generated with Python (Jinja2 templates)
- No JavaScript required for core reading experience
- WCAG AA accessibility compliant
- Privacy-preserving analytics (Plausible)
- No cookies, no tracking
